projection_control.scope: Unit-inertia angular row, unit bias impulse followed by exact unbiased velocity projection. Rotated-axis relaxation leaves a tangential component; neither method increases energy relative to pre-relax velocity. This is not proof of energy injection or a Rain defect, and does not authorize arbitrary cache transport. It distinguishes the bounded phase-consistency hypothesis only.
